### ✨ Overview

Average polish male, now in League of Legends.
This mod replaces Ezreal with Astolfo.

#

### ✨ Additional information

The mod replaces the Base Ezreal skin.

❗This skin is a [variant](https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Category:Skin_variants "skin variant - what is that?") of another custom skin: [Astolfo Ezreal Deluxe](https://divineskins.gg/Wiko/astolfo-ezreal-deluxe "astolfo ezreal but even more of a femboy :3")

#

### ✨ Features

* New model and textures
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game icons
